text: The leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of every ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the other nine remained in the towns.
And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

These are the heads of the province who settled in Jerusalem, while in the towns of Judah everyone lived on his own property in his own town — Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants, and the descendants of Solomon's servants.

In Jerusalem there settled some of the people of Judah and some of the people of Benjamin. From the people of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, of the descendants of Perez;
and Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of Col-hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, of the Shilonites.
All the descendants of Perez living in Jerusalem numbered 468 able men.
These are the Benjaminites: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah;
and after him Gabbai and Sallai — 928 in all.
Joel son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in charge of the city.
From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib; Jachin;
Seraiah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the chief officer of the house of God,
and their kinsmen who did the work of the house of God — 822; and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah,

versions.text: and their kinsmen who did the work of the house — 822; and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah,
versions.explanation: "the house" standing alone is unclear to a listener; since the same house (temple) is named explicitly in verses 11 and 16, spelling it out here aids oral comprehension.

text: and his kinsmen, heads of families — 242; and Amashsai son of Azarel, son of Ahzai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,
and their kinsmen, able warriors — 128. Their overseer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.
From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni;
Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who were in charge of the outside work of the house of God;

versions.text: Shabbethai and Jozabad, from the heads of the Levites, who were in charge of the outside work of the house of God;
versions.explanation: "from the heads of the Levites" is stiff and the sentence stalls when read aloud; "two of the heads of the Levites" conveys the partitive מֵ־ naturally.

text: Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zabdi, son of Asaph, who led the thanksgiving in prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his kinsmen; and Abda son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.
All the Levites in the holy city numbered 284.
The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their kinsmen who kept watch at the gates — 172.
The rest of Israel, with the priests and the Levites, lived in all the towns of Judah, each on his own inheritance.
The temple servants lived on Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.

The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica, one of the descendants of Asaph, the singers who served in the work of the house of God.
For there was a command from the king concerning them, a fixed provision for the singers, as each day required.
Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was at the king's side in all matters concerning the people.
As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba and its settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth-pelet,
in Hazar-shual, in Beersheba and its settlements,
in Ziklag, in Meconah and its settlements,
in En-rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
in Zanoah, Adullam and their villages, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its settlements. So they settled from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.
The Benjaminites lived from Geba onward, in Michmash, Aija, Bethel and its settlements,
Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
Lod, Ono, and the Valley of the Craftsmen.

versions.text: Lod, and Ono, the Valley of the Craftsmen.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew lists three place names in sequence. The present punctuation makes "the Valley of the Craftsmen" sound like an appositional explanation of Ono; a simple series is clearer and reads better aloud.

text: And certain divisions of the Levites from Judah were assigned to Benjamin.
